{text:body}

Redland City runs along the bay from Capalaba and Cleveland down to Redland Bay, and its roofs deal with salt air and a lot of trees. The big gums through Thornlands and Alexandra Hills, the same ones the local koalas live in, drop leaves and bark into gutters all year. Blocked valleys are behind most of the leaks we fix here. Gutter guard makes a real difference, and in bushfire-prone streets we fit ember-rated mesh. Alexandra Hills and Capalaba have many brick and tile homes from the 1970s and 80s that are due for repointing and a new coat. Closer to the water in Cleveland and Ormiston we use marine-grade sheeting and fixings, because standard ones rust quickly in the bay air. We also quote for homes on the Southern Moreton Bay Islands and plan those jobs around the barge from Redland Bay. A gutter clean and a roof repair can be quoted on the same visit.
